purpose: Compare three coordinated seed-to-GA routes under one frozen downstream GA and preserve output-retention, aggregation-weight and screening-eligibility analyses.
mpg_seed_definition: For each MPG-ascent start having at least one feasible retained visit, use exactly its archived highest frozen-task-quality feasible representative as an upstream pool member. Then apply the same per-support median-Q floor plus best-Q/farthest-point seed selector used by Generator-GA and R-GA.
mpg_ga_random_seed_formula: 3101000 + replicate*100 + 3; offset 3 was unused by the historical offsets 0,1,2
identity: support ID plus integer coordinates on the native 0.0001 lattice within run

evaluation.matched_selection: Reuse deterministic Q-upper-half plus farthest-point selection, cap 5 per support, and report candidate-weighted and support-equal summaries.
evaluation.screening: Preserve nominal Q>=0.75 and margin>=0.05 plus frozen bootstrap-sensitive eligibility where available.
evaluation.statistical_unit: five complete runs; candidates and supports are not independent replicates

prohibitions: no real numeric recipe as an initialization seed
no post-hoc change of GA parameters or route budget
no claim of equal wall-clock cost from equal candidate-attempt budgets
